item.subject: science
item.stem:
Radha is helping her grandmother in the kitchen. She notices four situations where heat is moving from one place to another.
In which situation is heat being transferred by convection?

options.A: The metal handle of a pan on the stove becomes hot while the dal is cooking.
options.B: Warm air rises from the room heater and cooler air moves in to take its place.
options.C: Meera feels warm sitting near a bonfire even though she is not touching it.
options.D: A spoon left in a glass of hot milk becomes warm along its whole length.
